summary.name: Kimi API Model Inference Pricing
summary.one_liner: Pricing documentation for Kimi API model inference, covering pay-as-you-go token billing, context caching, and the K2 and K3 model series.
use_cases: estimating cost of calling Kimi models via API
optimizing API costs with context caching
planning migration off retired K2 models
comparing Kimi API with subscription products
summary.what_it_does: The page lists pricing information for the Kimi API platform's model inference, organized by model series. It states that K3 series models support a 1,048,576-token context window and K2 series models support 262,144 tokens. Context caching billing is enabled automatically for repeated request prefixes, with a default TTL of 5 minutes, and the page links to best practices for TTL settings. Model inference is billed pay-as-you-go with no subscription plan, distinct from the Kimi membership and Kimi Code products. The page also announces that K2 models will stop being available to new users from October 31, 2026 and will be retired by the end of December 2026.
notable: Pay-as-you-go token billing with no subscription plan
Automatic context caching with default 5-minute TTL
K2 series scheduled for retirement by end of December 2026
caveats: K2 series no longer available to newly registered users from October 31, 2026
All K2 series models to be retired by end of December 2026
Specific per-token prices are not stated in the page text provided
